task.title: Venus health-factor replay and bounded intervention decision
task.exactDefinition: Given one frozen BNB Smart Chain testnet Venus account evidence bundle and one ordered exact-block observation window, calculate the account health factor at every declared observation; identify the first warning/critical threshold crossing, minimum health factor and evidence freshness; measure alert latency from source observation to output; and return canonical JSON choosing alert-only, no action, or a bounded unsigned intervention plan under the supplied policy. The timed comparison must not sign or broadcast.
task.successCondition: Both methods use the same immutable declaration and source receipts to produce reproducible per-observation calculations, threshold state, alert timing, policy decision, uncertainties and bounded plan without a stale-source substitution, hidden write, or unsupported safety claim.

inputs.description: Ordered exact-block raw account snapshots containing all supplied collateral, debt, balances, collateral factors, token decimals and market membership required for the calculation.
inputs.authoritativeSourceRequirement: Reviewed Venus BSC testnet contract reads at explicit block number/hash/timestamp, retained as hashed raw artifacts.
inputs.bindingRule: Choose and freeze the account and complete block window before run order; the window selection rule must not depend on either method's output.

inputs.description: Exact-block oracle prices, units/scales, collateral factors, liquidation thresholds and reviewed market/oracle contract identities for every supplied asset.
inputs.authoritativeSourceRequirement: Hashed raw contract/RPC responses and reviewed official Venus contract provenance.
inputs.bindingRule: Bind values and unit scales from the same declared observation blocks; missing or stale prices remain explicit blockers.

binding.reason: The final account markets, oracle sources and block window are unknown.

inputs.description: Warning, critical and liquidation-risk thresholds; alert latency target; allowed decision set; maximum repay/spend; assets; expiry; recipient; human-confirmation and revoke requirements.
inputs.authoritativeSourceRequirement: Canonical ProofEra health-guardian policy artifact reviewed and hashed before both runs.
inputs.bindingRule: Bind thresholds as exact scaled integers and all amounts in base units; keep policy identical for both methods and prohibit timed execution.

binding.reason: The final account and safe intervention limits are not selected.

inputs.description: Source-observed UTC/monotonic timestamps for each block response used to compute freshness and alert latency.
inputs.authoritativeSourceRequirement: Injected runner timing artifact joined to each raw response digest.
inputs.bindingRule: Capture timestamps during evidence acquisition before either decision run; never backfill or infer missing latency timestamps.

constraints.description: The account, contracts, receipts and declaration must use BNB Smart Chain testnet chain ID 97.
Neither timed run may approve, repay, borrow, redeem, transfer, sign, submit or broadcast.
All balances, prices, factors and health-factor comparisons must use declared integer scales; floating-point financial arithmetic is forbidden.
A missing, stale, wrong-network or unit-ambiguous source must block an intervention recommendation and remain explicit in output.
Finish the timed replay within 900 seconds; later completion remains recorded and loses timing/reproducibility credit.

criteria.description: Correctly validate sources and calculate collateral, debt and health factor for every observation with explicit units.
criteria.measurement: Recompute each integer calculation from raw exact-block responses and compare canonical fields.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Raw state/price responses, calculation trace, unit manifest and canonical output.

criteria.description: Identify the first threshold crossing, minimum health factor and alert latency without backfilled timestamps.
criteria.measurement: Compare output indices/times with the frozen ordered window and injected timing record.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Observation/timing manifest, threshold trace and raw output.

criteria.description: Choose only an allowed decision and ensure any unsigned intervention plan respects amount, asset, target, recipient, expiry and confirmation bounds.
criteria.measurement: Validate decision and decoded plan against every frozen policy field; stale/unknown evidence must block intervention.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Policy artifact, canonical decision, decoded plan or explicit no-plan state and validation log.

criteria.description: Explain liquidation risk, trigger rationale, missing evidence and limits without claiming guaranteed protection.
criteria.measurement: Apply the fixed decision-usefulness and overclaim checklist to unedited output.

criteria.description: Provide deterministic canonical output, source/receipt joins, complete timing/costs and reproducible commands.
criteria.measurement: Second reviewer reruns the exact declaration and checks every artifact hash and API receipt.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Reproduction log, raw/canonical outputs, active/wall timing, cost evidence and receipt verification.

hardFailRules: Wrong chain, account, market, token, decimal scale, collateral factor, oracle, price block, threshold, recipient, or source window.
Any signature, approval, repay, borrow, redeem, transfer, submission, broadcast, or other write during the timed run.
Any floating-point financial calculation, fabricated state/price/latency/receipt, silently replaced missing response, or intervention recommendation from stale or unit-ambiguous evidence.
Any input, constraint, environment, source access, policy, observation window, or rubric difference between methods.

pairProtocol.runOrderRule: Freeze the complete account window, policy, source receipts and shared declaration first; then select order from recorded public randomness and do not refresh or extend the window between runs.
pairProtocol.agentMethodRequirement: Hire the registered Health-Factor Guardian through ProofEra, retain its identity/hire evidence, and invoke only the frozen agent configuration against the shared declaration.
pairProtocol.manualMethodRequirement: One declared operator calculates and decides from the same bundle without invoking the hired agent, using only predeclared official read tools and a frozen manual worksheet/procedure.

Second-reviewer recomputation, criterion scoring and source/receipt verification.
